batting.name: H Klaasen
batting.dismissal: c Tilak Varma b JJ Bumrah

batting.name: Aniket Verma
batting.dismissal: c RD Rickelton b HH Pandya

balls.text: Middle stump turns into a leaning tower. Cummins went across early for the scoop, got too far across the line and couldn't make contact with the yorker
Low fully on leg, reverse swept along the ground to deep point

Inside edged onto the stumps. Replays show it might be a hit wicket. Kishan's might not be the most interesting wicket of this innings. This was a low full toss around off, Abhinav was deep in the crease for it, tried to steer it square on the off side. Chomped the bat onto the bails, new zings being brought out
Full on the pads, landed just in front of the crease, Cummins opened his hips and clipped to deep midwicket
Yorker on leg, clipped through wide mid-on. He wants two but long-on is quick to it
Slower bouncer is wide, Abhinav wound up early but had to delay his shot a bit. Cleared the front leg, got deep in the crease and flat-batted it over long-on. Remarkable power to clear the man
Another full toss, whipped off the pads but finds deep backward square. Klaasen is dejected but has kept SRH in the game, somewhat, after a horror start. 300th T20 wicket for Bumrah

Klaasen premeditated bigtime. Knew the yorker was coming. The stance didn't change, but the bat turned in the hands before the release and he was helped it over short third. Amazing how controlled a reverse lap can be
Yorker, jammed through midwicket. Klaasen wants two, takes the fielder on... and they make it. Throw at the non-striker's, Bumrah let it go but there was no direct hit
Yorker on leg, Abhinav's feet get dispersed as he gets nutmegged. Ball dribbles leg side

SKY bobbles a chance at long-on. He ran in and tried to take a bread-basket catch, the ball poured off the palmd onto his knee and bounced too far in front. Was a 141ks low full toss that was driven off the bottom of the bat

Full toss decks Abhinav. 135ks, hit him around the right hip. Yorker missed by quite a distance but that came from a low trajectory at pace. The batter was making room and crouched as he tried to flick it. No apologies, at least not right away but think there was a gesture later. Physio comes out for a check
Shortish ball, cramped a bit but pulled to deep midwicket
Slapped over cover. That area's being peppered. Was a slot ball wide of off and Abhinav used a diagonal bat to skim it over the infield

Run-out chance. Klaasen stopped in disappointment after mistiming the late cut. The ball went off the toe to short third. Throw at the non-striker's. Nearly half-volleyed Hardik. He collected it and broke the stumps, gave enough time for Klaasen to reach home
127ks bouncer around head-height, pulled into the ground. Finds deep midwicket
Abhinav connects this time. The ball's full, which helped. He made room, cleared the front leg and launched a drive inside out over extra cover
Slower one beats the lofted cover drive on the inside edge. No, it's actually seam-up, that actually decked in off a length. Landed around sixth and came back
Another yorker attempt, this lands just outside the crease and is slanting towards middle. Abhinav gave away all his stumps and heaved across the line, got it off the inside-half to long-on
This is perfect from Bumrah. Yoker just down leg, not an issue as Abhinav slid outside leg and got followed. Jammed back to the bowler
Yorker's nearly nailed this time. Jammed to long-on
Another missed yorker. Full toss this time. Pace on. Mid-off was in and Klaasen drove over him. Hardik was running back and lifted his hand but knew he had no chance
Yorker missed. The full ball spearing in towards middle is flogged to long-on. Off the inside half of the bat
SRH keep taking Bumrah down. Slower bouncer around neck-height, Abhinav pulls between fine leg and square leg. Bottom hand came off but he cleared the infield easily
10 o' clock release. Fullish and slow on leg, flicked to long-on. Santner ends his quota with 0 for 19
Length on leg, clipped leg side off the back foot

That's not a pull ball but Klaasen does it, somehow gets it over the bowler too. Klaasen looked to make room and was on the move as Santner tried to follow him with the length ball. Klaasen was somehow beside the line enough to flat bat it

Tease from Santner, loops it super slow, fullish too. Manohar tries dragging it from just outside off with a slog sweep. Off the toe it goes to long-on. Manohar turned for two and was sent back early enough for there not to be any danger
Darted onto a length, leg-stump line, worked to long-on
Slow on a fullish length around off, lots of loop but it races after pitching, cut to deep point
Yorker just outside off, smothers a flick to long-on
Slow. 116ks, Fullish on leg, clipped to deep midwicket
Another yorker attempt. 137ks. It lands just in front of the crease, Manohar whips it to long-on
Slower three-quarter-length ball just outside off goes past the cut.
Fifty for Klaasen, gets there by swat-pulling the slower bouncer from outside off to cow corner. He raises his bat and gets hearty applause from the crowd
Wide, slow and full. The angle takes the 113ks ball well outside off after landing just inside the tramline. Let go
Missed yorker. Low full toss on leg, clipped through midwicket. No one in the ring, bisects long-on and deep-mid. Fifty partnership
Touch quicker to finish. 97ks, length on fourth, cut to deep point. Another miserly over
Slow. Length on middle, stock ball straightens a touch and is flicked to deep square leg
Slow on a length at leg and middle, punched to the bowler's left
Touch quicker to Klaasen, at the pads. On a length but gets good bounce and pace off the pitch, punched off the back foot to long-on
Slingier, shortish and quicker. Worked off the back foot to long-on
Another dot. This wasn't a great ball as such, full and slow on off, went straight, driven back to the bowler
Pitched up on the pads, flicked through the gap at midwicket
Slower bouncer with four fielders on or behind square. It rises around head-height and was outside off, Manohar left it hoping for a wide. Doesn't get it, he smiles in resignation
Goes for the yorker, ends up overpitching on fifth. Manohar toes an away-from-the-body drive back to the bowler
Of course it's a bouncer. Angle's a touch off though. It's just down leg, Manohar shrugs aside

Inside out over extra. Brave shot to the best bowler with SRH at 70 for 5. It's a length ball, on the fuller side, angling in towards off, Manohar didn't move his feet, just extended his bat high and held his shape on the drive
No action right away. On the pads, helped along to fine leg

Five dots to finish. Length ball at the stumps is punched off the back foot to the bowler's right. He scoots and stops it with his right hand, looks in pain though. Not sure if it was while trying to catch the ball or if he brushed the batter while moving
Slow on a length just outside off, driven to cover
Touch quicker, release is a touch wider too. Fullish on fourth, driven back to the bowler
Slow again. Tossed up on a length just outside off. Abhinav's bottom hand comes off after punching it to cover
Slow to Abhinav, beats the flick. Gets good bounce, hits just over the knee roll after beating the flick. Was a length ball on leg
Looked quicker. On a length, off stump, skiddy ball but Klaasen's happy to go on the back foot. Clears the front leg and cut to deep point
Similar ball, driven to sweeper cover
Pitched up, crunched through extra cover. Likely the slower one, but Klaasen got the back-lift high and drove through the line. On the up, vertical bat shot with a late check. Hardik's impressed
Wide on a short of length, cut through cover this time. Along the ground
This is literally short and wide, 122ks, rises around head-height. Was close to the off-side tramline, Klaasen jumped and cut it over cover. Signs that the pitch is still good to bat
Slower one shoots low. Off a length, fifth stump, Klaasen looks to delay his square drive and go low, is beaten nonetheless
Back of length but doesn't bounce much. Likely slow, angle in takes the ball onto Klaasen's hips. He crouches and pulls it late, to the left of short fine it goes
Bouncer, very short, rises above the batter. Let go
Floated full on middle, eased down to long-off, 15 off Puthur's first
Flatter on a length on leg, he goes back and punches it to cover
Klaasen Klobbers this! Too short again, spins in after landing on leg,  Klaasen goes back and pulls it over square leg
Fuller and quicker on leg, 82.5kph, pushed back to the bowler
Darts it wide on a length, similar result. Once again it is short enough for Klaasen to go back, wait and pick his spot - this time he slaps it over extra cover
Welcomed with a meaty six! Slow, loopy ball on a length on leg, Klaasen had all the time in the world to go back and send it into the deep midwicket stand
Outside off on a length, punched to deep cover
Length ball outside off, taps it in front of cover-point for one
Length ball on off and middle, gets a soft leading edge towards the bowler

Edged and gone! The short-ball strategy works for Hardik against Aniket. He digs it in again, Aniket looks to charge down and swat it away but only gets a thin edge. No mistake from Rickelton and Hardik barely celebrates. SRH go from bad to worse, not what many of us expected
Charges down the short ball and looks to pull but is a tad early into it and cops a blow
Bumper to start, just outside off, Aniket sinks to let it pass. One for the over called
Lands it on a length, slower this time, on leg, he goes back and punches it to long-on
Flatter and outside off, goes back and slaps it to deep cover, 94.1kph
Floated full on middle, driven towards extra cover
Flatter and on a length just outside off, 90.3kph, cut away behind point for two. Puthur does well in the deep
Slower through the air on middle and leg, pushed through mid-on
Quicker length ball to start with. it skids on, Aniket goes back to heave it away but misses
Fuller and outside off, punched nicely off the front foot to deep cover. It was 119.3kph, Chahar done for the night
Length ball on off, punched down to long-on
Moving away on a length, he punches it off the outer half and is dejected
Full and outside off, driven to mid-off
Klaaaaas shot! Picks the length early and almost sends it sailing. Heaves it aerially and just wide of deep midwicket. Just bounces inside the rope
Length ball outside off, it is the knuckle ball, he gets it back to the bowler off the inner half
Another length ball, angling in on off, whipped through forward square leg
Slanting in on middle and leg, 136.5kph, clipped wide of short fine leg
Angling in on the pad, Aniket takes full toll. He gets inside the line and helps it away fine on the leg side with the angle. The man in the deep was quite square
Length ball aimed at off, defended from the crease
Length ball just outside off, 135.7kph, punched wide of mid-off
Almost a catch straight up! Length ball on off, 134.5kph, Klaasen chips it almost back at the bowler. Just out of reach to Bumrah's left
Outside off on a length, 134.7kph, punched to backward point
Length ball just outside off, defended to point
Length ball outside off, punched to mid-off for a quick run. Hardik misses his shy at the bowler's end
Length ball outside off, punched to mid-off
Length ball outside off, opens the face to guide it to deep third

Driven straight to mid-on's left, catching practice for Santner. NKR's season going from bad to worse. Length ball on off, Reddy drives it down on the up and straight to the man in the ring. Dull faces in the SRH dugout
Angling away on a length, slashed to backward point, 139.3kph, just one run, a wicket and lots of trees from that over
Length ball just outside off, 136.4kph, not much swing, punched straight to short cover
Full and wide outside off, 136.3kph, he looks to squeeze it away but misses

And Abhishek is out of here now! A tame fall for the other half of Travishek. Length ball outside off, not fully pace-on - 127.1kph, it is the knuckle ball. Abhishek throws his hand at it to thrash it through off side but it flies off the outer half straight to Puthur at cover-point. MI on a roll and are all over SRH
Length ball on off, punched to cover, 139.1kph
Length ball on off, glided to deep third
Abhishek gets away with a miscue now. Short ball on leg, 127.2kph, he pulls it with the bat held like a periscope. Boult charges in from deep square leg but it lands well short of him
Length ball outside off, steered to deep third
Full on middle, driven straight back at the stumps at the other end
Length ball on middle and off, defended to the on side
Length ball on muddle, defended to the on side

Length ball swinging down leg, he's given it out!. Wait. The umpire perhaps spots Kishan walking off and raises his finger. He initially signalled wide. None of Chahar or Rickelton really appealed but Kishan walked. And he was patted on his head by Hardik for doing so. Second time this season that he has been strangled down leg, though he could have got away with this one had he not walked. Chahar was going back to his mark and only put in half an appeal after the umpire turned his wide call into an out. What's more, NOTHING ON THE SNICKO!
Whipped away in fine fashion. Full and on middle, Boult delivers it there at 132.8kph anticipating some outswing. Instead it is right in Abhishek's arc and he sends it sailing over wide long-on
Fuller on off, driven wide of mid-off for a quick run
Closer to off, Kishan feels for it again and is beaten again. Getting squared up with the outswing
Feels for it and almost nicks it. Swinging away from a length, he pokes at it and is lucky to get away

Skied high and Head falls early for a three-ball duck Boult's away swing does it and once again it is a night without some Travishek blitz. Intentions were clear as soon as he saw a length ball outside off. He looks to smash it over cover but there is a slight away movement and he doesn't have eyes on the ball. It goes off the top edge , Dhir runs in from deep backward point and pouches it safely
Length ball angling in on middle and leg, not much lateral movement there. Head goes for the whip but misses
Swinging away from a length around leg, once again punched straight to cover. Just the one extra prevents the over from being a maiden
Length ball moving away, punched to cover, 127.1kph
Length ball starts outside leg and swinging towards the stumps, defended back down the track, 131.7kph

Straight back at Chahar via the inner half. Did it carry? Looks so from Rickelton and slip's reaction. Low full toss swinging in a touch, he goes for the drive through the off side but it goes back low to the bowler
A bouncer first ball from Chahar to Abhishek, 121.9kph, he leaves it be and it is called wide. Hardik doesn't think it is wide and shakes his head, but doesn't review
An appeal that dies down quickly. This is on a length and swinging in, Head charges down and goes for the whip but misses. It was bowled at 134.1kph but would have been sliding down leg
Starts with a length ball at 129.2kph, It starts outside leg and swings towards middle and leg. Head gets behind and defends it from the crease

Pulled. Should've been out, but the ball goes through Reddy's hands. He points to the floodlights. Another one-bounce four over midwicket. Was a shortish googly around middle, SKY pulled and swivelled. Might've got it off the bottom of the bat but got away with it
Zeeshan goes for it again, goes a touch wider and rips the legbreak sharply. Ball finishes well outside off and sails past bat

Looped teasingly, SKY might've beaten on the flight but went through with the slog sweep. Bottom hand came off but the whiplash and power couldn't be stopped. Ball goes over the infield at midwicket for a one-bounce four
Wide, fullish and slow. Sits up for the pull to deep midwicket. Played square-on

SKY's walked down and helped it along simultaneously! He wanted to negate a potential yorker, Malinga missed his length, got it around knee-high but it was speeding in. Nonetheless, it was whipped over fine leg
Overpitched, punched through cover

Soft dismissal. Rohit's chipped a yorker straight to midwicket. 142ks following him as he made room, his back foot slid and the closed bat-faced jammed in. There was reverse swing, so the ball came closer to him than he expected and his arms were buckled. The movement was late too, so he couldn't change the shot. Great innings though
Looked like a pace-on bouncer off the hand but a slower one off the pitch. Didn't rise, cut to deep point
Full toss is caressed over long-on. Mid-on was in, so it was a calculated shot. Reached out to lift the slower ball from around knee-height, played from in front of the body
Full down leg. Goes past the attempted whip before SKY shouldered arms
Full on middle and leg, might've been a missed yorker. Rohit tries whipping it over midwicket, inside edges to deep fine leg
Dipping yorker from wide of the crease. Flicked off middle stump to deep square leg
Deep fine leg was out and Rohit sweeps it right there. Very skilful to pick it up off a length, was a fourth-stump ball and Rohit got on one knee paddled before driving the bat through
Full ball from a wide release angles in sharply, Rohit uses it by flicking aerially over midwicket
Yep, proper short and wide. Pace on. SKY hops, cuts and lands back on one foot before running. Ball goes to deep third
Yorker on off, lands around the crease, jammed towards midwicket
Short and wide to start. Pace on too, Rohit curs hard and late. Gets it in the gap to the left of backward point
Chops the length ball outside off to point

Near yorker. SKY went back in the crease and tried to flick behind square. Got nutmegged, ball brushed the inside of the pad and was rushing to Klaasen's left. He hurries low and manages to stop it. Might've got it on the edge of the finger, looks like it's stinging
Mid-on and mid-off are in, so SKY has a heave. The slower ball outside off around a three-quarter length almost rolls along the ground to pass below bat
Upper cuts a slower bouncer with a flourish. Deep third runs left to stop it. That ball might've landed a third of the way into the pitch and well above head-height
Wide yorker. Around the tramline, SKY reaches out and swishes. Beaten. Not given wide

Pitched up on middle, SKY's across to off and flicks the offcutter right between deep fine leg and square leg. Both fielders were converging and one ran over the boundary, likely to avoid a collision.
Full around off, pushed to long-on
Ah, but Zeeshan misses his line. Maybe not by all that much actually. The googly is just outside off, SKY stays leg side of the ball and made it look wider than it was. Cut through point with power
SKYs sweeping was impeccable last game and it's continuing here. Big stride forward, turns a fullish length ball into a full one and whacks it along square leg.
Likely a googly. 90ks spinning back towards off from a shortish length. Flat trajectory. Cut to backward point
Premeditated reverse... Think Rohit wanted to sweep but had to pull it in the end. Through where first slip would have been. Was a shortish ball that dipped and went towards top of off
Makes room, slides the back leg leg side and drives inside out over extra. Long-off stops it. The full ball was at the stumps
Inside edges a slog onto pad, ball deflects to point. 138ks fullish ball angling in towards leg, Rohit wanted to go wide of mid-on
Three-quarter length, close to the tramline; waits, reaches out and checks a cut to cover.
Top edges a pull but it lands just past the ring at square leg. Bumper was just outside off
Yorker on middle, 140ks, flicked through midwicket. Long-on runs right to stop it. SKY wanted two but was sent back. Fifty for Rohit, big cheers again, both from the crowd and those in MI jerseys
Slow, wide, and it's cut. Reddy charges left from deep point and slides, tries to flick it in but parries it onto the ropes. Good effort nonetheless. Was a length ball but sat up nicely
Misses the yorker. Shin-high fully at the stumps is flicked to midwicket
Full on off, flicked to long-on
Even slower maybe. Yeah, 77ks. Was wide, Rohit waited and belted it with the horizontal bat. Picked out cover
83ks. Fullish length ball on middle, spins to off, defended to cover point
Length just outside off, punched to deep point off the back foot
Overpitched, but it leads to the wicket. Jacks slid leg side to the 91ks ball on middle and leg, drove through the line but straight to Mahohar's bread basket
Full on leg, legbreak at 94ks, flicked to long-on. 91ks, at middle and leg,
Slower three-quarter-length ball close to the off-side tramline. Jacks reaches out cuffs it off the splice. Into the pitch, back to the bowler
Length outside off, steered to deep third with the fully open bat face
This is slow, Rohit helps it away anyway. Waits for the slower bouncer to arrive towards his right shoulder and pulled it just behind square. 42-metre gap there. Nicely bisected
Low dipping full toss. Not slow, speedometer says - 132ks. Pushed back to the bowler
Pitched up, Jacks gets leg side of the 132ks ball and tries to whip it aerially. Edges it to long leg
Slow and fullish just outside off, tapped through point
Quicker length ball outside off, punched to deep cover
Fuller outside off, swept through short fine leg
Loopy full ball outside off, pushed to cover
Quicker one, hurled in shorter outside off, he charges down, pauses and punched through cover
Launched over long-on! Rohit picked the googly early. It was full, in the slot, he cleared his front leg, on his knee and bhaaam
Legspinner fuller around off, pushed to cover
Full on off, glanced through to long-on, 136.4kph, another quiet over from HP
Length ball angling in on off and middle, punched defensively from the crease. Rohit indicating it nipped back sharply
Length ball outside off, nips back in a touch, he goes for the slash but misses
Low full toss on off, flicked through midwicket
Back of a length legcutter outside off, 132.1kph, punched through backward poinr
Bouncer outside off, not much pace on it, pulled all along the ground to deep midwicket
Full and swinging in on middle, flicked wide of mid-on. Reddy runs to his left, dives and keeps it to one
Slower full ball on off, Rohit looks to flick it but gets a thick inside degd onto his pad and towards short midwicket
Full o off, flicked to mid-on for a quick one
Fuller and tailing in on middle, nudged to midwicket
Creeaaammmmeeddd! Slow full toss outside off, sits up nicely for a punch from Jacks. He delayed his shot just a little bit and that was enough for him to time it away from cover and deep extra cover
Launched over extra cover. A 139.2kph length ball outside off, Jacks has the desired width, he stands tall and slaps it over the in-field
Low full toss on off, sliced towards cover. A quiet over from Harshal after the two before went for 30
Slower full ball outside off, 113.7kph, pushed towards cover for a quick one
Jacks backs away early, Harshal follows him with a 130.9kph length ball that is punched to cover
Dipping low full toss around off, clipped to deep square leg
Low full toss just outside off, flicked straight to short midwicket
Length ball on off, pushed back to the bowler
In line of the stumps, turned through midwicket to retain strike, 13 off the over

Oh my word. Rohit of old is back in Hyderabad! Ofcutter on a length outside off, no pace at all on that one. Rohit clears his front leg and manufactures all the pace he needs to launch it over extra cover
Slower bouncer outside off, pulled to deep midwicket
Slower one on middle, he gets back and across and nudges it to fine leg
Very full on off, squeezed out back to the bowler

Cracked away with power. Rohit charges down the track early, Unadkat goes short. He has two men manning the longer square boundary but it doesn't matter to Rohit, who pulls it away through forward quare leg

Whacked high and handsome! Another back-of-a-length ball around off, this one is pace-on. Jacks has picked it early, gets on his toes and heaves it into the second tier over deep midwicket. Expensive over from Cummins, 17 off it
Back of a length ball outside off, pushed towards covers off the back foot
Angling in on middle, 139.8kph, clipped through backward square leg

Tickled away fine. Shortish and angling in again, Rohit gets inside the line and looks to pull it fine. Gets enough glove on it to take it fine and well away from the fielder in the deep who is very square
Pull. Rohit. Six! He has seen that well, all right. Cummins bowls an offcutter into the surface, Rohit lines it up well, has enough time to pull it well over forward square leg
Length ball angling in on off, he defends it towards short midwicket
Around the wicket on a length on off, defended back down the track
Slanting away on a length, steered to backward point

What a catch! Early wicket for SRH. Unadkat lands it on a length around off, it holds a bit in the surface. Rickelton chips it back, Unadkat sticks his left hand out and he sticks. His momentum was taking him to his right, which is why it is an excellent take
Slower one, full around off, taps it towards cover. Wants a run but Rohit says no

Thickish outside edge. Or might have deliberate. On a length outside off, 131.8kph, a bit of movement away. Rickelton plays away from his body with soft hands, it goes off the outer half between short third and backward point
Back of a length on leg, he hops and tucks it through square leg
Full on middle, he comes forward and flicks it to mid-on for a quick single
Slanting away on a length, slapped to deep cover-point

Half-minded run and a confusion between the fielders. Result? Two runs for MI. Rickelton taps it towards and takes off, pauses and continues running. Extra cover runs in, Reddy swoops in too from mid-off. Eventually both of them leave it for the other
Length ball on off, punched to mid-off. Takes off for a run, Rohit responds and then is sent back. Shy missed by NKR at the bowler's end. Ro would have been in though
Sweeeeet! Not a driveable length that. Just around good length, outside off. Rickelton leans into it and places it through cover, beats the fielder and takes four to get going
Length ball on off and middle to start, punched back defensively off the crease
